faces.name: Valgavoth's Onslaught
faces.oracleText: Manifest dread X times, then put X +1/+1 counters on each of those creatures. (To manifest dread, look at the top two cards of your library, then put one onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature and the other into your graveyard. Turn it face up any time for its mana cost if it's a creature card.)

faces.name: Valgavoth, Harrower of Souls
faces.oracleText:
Flying
Ward—Pay 2 life.
Whenever an opponent loses life for the first time during each of their turns, put a +1/+1 counter on Valgavoth and draw a card.

faces.name: Valgavoth, Terror Eater
faces.oracleText:
Flying, lifelink
Ward—Sacrifice three nonland permanents.
If a card you didn't control would be put into an opponent's graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.
During your turn, you may play cards exiled with Valgavoth. If you cast a spell this way, pay life equal to its mana value rather than pay its mana cost.

faces.name: Valgavoth, the Lifeline
faces.oracleText:
Flying
Whenever you gain life, creature cards in your hand and graveyard perpetually get +1/+1.
As long as you've gained life this turn, you may cast creature spells from your graveyard. If you cast a spell this way, that creature enters with a finality counter on it.
